artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan: repo-wide git-ls-files enumeration in check-task-references.sh (option (a), coverage, over option (b), carve-out), PATH_SCOPE membership check dropped, validate-wiring.sh missing-tree-root SKIP guards, two new fixture-driven test suites including lint/hook scope-agreement, and the enforcement narrative rewritten off the four-root model.

memory_candidates.content: When a lint/gate script's output is consumed by another script, the consumer's parsing contract -- not the script's whole output -- is what must be preserved across a redesign. check-task-references.sh's per-tree summary lines were freely replaceable, but verify-deploy.sh gate 4 greps '^  [^:]+:[0-9]+:' out of the non-quiet output to build its FINDING list, so the per-finding line shape (leading two spaces, colon-free relative path) is the real interface. Before reshaping any gate script's reporting, grep every caller for what it actually parses: exit code, one line regex, or the summary text. Asserting the consumer's regex inside the producer's OWN test suite makes a future reshaping break locally instead of silently degrading a downstream gate.
